title: Figure 10: hydrogen-1 and boron-11 fusion producing three alpha particles
description: Particle diagram showing a hydrogen-1 nucleus and a boron-11 nucleus (cluster of red and blue spheres) converging on a fusion point and producing three helium-4 nuclei, labelled "3 x ⁴He + 8.7 MeV." Captioned "Figure 10. The Fusion of Hydrogen-1 and Boron-11 Produces Three Alpha Particles." The text discusses lithium-6 and boron-11 availability and bremsstrahlung losses in aneutronic fusion.
